comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from workpieces, versus clamping a glued panel with clamps alternating above and below.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen manipulation versus clamp placement, tightening and distributed force control across a panel.
comparison.success_condition: Recovery, retention and spill-free dwell versus aligned panel held by the required effective clamp arrangement.
comparison.reason: Distributed clamping is a different tested ability from orientation-dependent sifting.
